sections.section: ORDER - President's Order 17, Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Ninth Amendment) Order 1985
sections.description:
PRESIDENT'S ORDER 17 OF 1985
PRESIDENT'S ORDER
17 OF 1985
HOUSES OF
PARLIAMENT AND PROVINCIAL ASSEMBLIES (ELECTIONS) (NINTH AMENDMENT) ORDER, 1985
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 7th March, 1985]
No. F. 17(3)/85-Pub.--The
following Order, made by the President, is hereby published for general
information.
In pursuance of the Proclamation
of the fifth day of July, 1977, and in exercise of all powers enabling him in
that behalf, the President is pleased to make the following Order :-
1. Short title and commencement.-(1) This Order may be
called the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) (Ninth
Amend ment) Order, 1985.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of Article 10. P. (P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977.--In
the Houses of Parliament and Provincial Assemblies (Elections) Order, 1977 [P.
(P. P.) O. No. 5 of 1977], in Article 10, after clause (3), the following new
clause shall be added, namely :-
"(4) A
person shall be disqualified from being elected or chosen as, and from being, a
member of the Senate if, having been a candidate for election. to the National
Assembly or a Provincial Assembly at the elections held under this Order he has
not been elected to such Assembly."
